description: This PHP class 'EmploymentContractService' manages employment contract attachments within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to retrieve, save, and delete contract-related employee attachments.

classes.name: EmploymentContractService
classes.description: Service class for managing employment contract attachments, including retrieval, saving, and deletion of employee attachments related to employment contracts.

methods.name: getEmploymentContractDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmploymentContractDao, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeAttachmentService, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getContractAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the first employee attachment for a given employee number related to employment contracts.

methods.name: getContractAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee attachment by attachment ID for a given employee number.

methods.name: saveContractAttachment
methods.description: Saves an employee attachment as a contract attachment.

methods.name: deleteContractAttachment
methods.description: Deletes a specified employee attachment related to a contract.
